key_points.text: What still belongs uniquely to humans?

thesis: The podcast argues that AI functions as a creative tool similar to a guitar or sampler rather than replacing human point of view, as the computer only executes instructions based on data provided by humans. It further suggests that while AI democratizes creation by removing the need to learn to code, the real strength of the technology lies in its potential to eventually possess its own thoughts, which currently remains unrealized.
